app.name: Listen & Speak Nepali
app.shareMessage: Listen & Speak Nepali — an instant-composition training app for learning Nepali from English

levels.desc1: Basic words and short sentences. Practical everyday expressions.
levels.desc2: Complex sentences and conjunctions. Conversation and explanation.
levels.desc3: Abstract content and idioms. Complex grammatical structures.

grammarThemes.6: Theme 6｜Question words and how to ask
grammarThemes.7: Theme 7｜Pronouns, familiarity, respect and verb agreement
grammarThemes.29: Theme 29｜Relative expressions: people, things, place and time
grammarThemes.31: Theme 31｜Inference / opinion / possibility (I think / probably / might / must be)
grammarThemes.35: Theme 35 (Appendix A)｜Verb forms through writing: लेख्नु
grammarThemes.36: Theme 36 (Appendix B)｜Copulas through identity and location

themeScreen.title: Choose a theme
themeScreen.headerConv: Choose a theme and challenge yourself to form Nepali sentences on the spot. Keep practicing until Nepali comes naturally, without having to think.
themeScreen.headerGrammar: Pick a theme and learn its grammatical structures.
themeScreen.headerListen: Choose a theme and start listening. Listen again and again to develop a natural feel for Nepali.
themeScreen.compositionDesc: Choose grammar or conversation, then practise making Nepali sentences on your own.
themeScreen.puzzleDesc: Arrange the word tiles to build Nepali sentences. Choose a theme and practise at your own pace.

levelScreen.title: Choose a level
levelScreen.desc: Choose a difficulty for the theme "{{theme}}".

vocab.themeSelectDesc: Choose a direction and a theme to practise with four-choice quizzes.
vocab.directionDesc: Which direction would you like to practise the words in "{{category}}"?
vocab.neToJaDesc: Read the Nepali word and choose its English meaning from four options.
vocab.jaToNeDesc: Read the English meaning and choose the Nepali word from four options.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Customize your learning experience. Settings are saved automatically.
settings.playbackSpeedDesc: Playback speed shared across all modes
settings.nepaliRepeatDesc: How many times Nepali is played during listening
settings.convDirectionDesc: Translation direction for grammar and conversation sentences
settings.listenOrderDesc: Which language is played first in Listening Mode
settings.listenLoopDesc: Return to the start after reaching the end
settings.gapDesc: Wait time between Nepali and the next audio
settings.romajiDesc: Show Nepali pronunciation in Roman letters
settings.resetConfirmDesc: Restore all settings to their defaults?
